name: gamenet_handle_pkt0b_chat_message
description: GameNet::HandlePkt0B_ChatMessage clamps a network chat payload to 80 bytes, null-terminates it, and displays it through the HUD chat feed.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet packet-handler/HUD source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4337e0 validates the 0x51-byte local zeroed message buffer, signed 16-bit packet length load, clamp at 0x50 bytes, positive-length payload copy from packet offset 0x0a, explicit terminator write, HudUi::ShowChatLine call with 5.0f duration, and one return.
The native chat-message packet smoke verifies a short payload is displayed with 5.0 seconds duration and an overlong payload is clamped to the packet message buffer size before display.
